blocks.prompt: 5. How many arrangements of the letters of the word ATTACKED can be made if each arrangement begins with C and ends with K?
blocks.explanation:
Pehli jagah par C aur aakhri jagah par K pakka hai; sirf beech ke letters hil sakte hain.
Find kya karna hai? Aise kitne lafz ban sakte hain.
Plan: C aur K ko alag kar dein, bache hue letters ginein, dohraye gaye letters dekhein, phir formula lagayen.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: lafz ATTACKED; har arrangement C se shuru ho kar K par khatam ho.
Humein find karna hai: aisi arrangements ki ginti.
Tareeqa: Sirf un letters par \(\dfrac{n!}{n_1!\,n_2! \cdots}\) lagana hai jo hil sakte hain.

C aur K ko fix karein
\[\text{C}\ \_\ \_\ \_\ \_\ \_\ \_\ \text{K}\]
Kyun: Jo letter ek hi jagah ja sakta hai us ka sirf 1 tareeqa hai, is liye woh ginti ko nahi badalta. Sawal ki shart pehle poori kar dena hamesha aasaan raasta hai.

Beech ke letters likhein
A, T, T, A, E, D
\[n = 6,\quad \text{A} = 2,\ \text{T} = 2\]
Kyun: ATTACKED mein 8 letters hain: A, T, T, A, C, K, E, D. C aur K nikaal dein to 6 bachte hain, jin mein A do dafa aur T do dafa hai.
Dhyan dein: C aur K ko bhi beech ke letters mein gin lena aam ghalti hai; woh pehle hi apni jagah par beth chuke hain.

Formula lagayen
\[\dfrac{6!}{2!\,2!} = \dfrac{720}{4} = 180\]
Kyun: Agar beech ke 6 letters sab alag hote to 6! = 720 tarteebein hotin. Lekin do A aapas mein jagah badlein ya do T badlein, lafz wahi rehta hai; is liye 2! aur 2! se divide kiya. E aur D ek ek dafa hain, un ke liye kuch divide nahi hota.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{8!}{2!\,2!} = 10080 \text{ (no condition)}\]
Kyun: Agar koi shart na hoti to 10080 lafz bante; shart lagne se jawab bohat kam (180) hona chahiye, aur hai. Computer se C...K wale tamam lafz gine gaye to bhi 180 aaye.
